options.reason: The table was evidently assembled to predict abalone age, which is recorded as the number of rings; that makes it a single-count numeric outcome, so this is a regression study on Rings from Sex plus the size and weight measurements. No column is a row key, no column encodes a re-scored version of Rings, and no grouping or chronological ordering exists, so identifier, leakage, group and time lists stay empty and the workflow default metric is used.
options.title: regression
